earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Micron reported record fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $41.46 billion, up sharply from $23.86 billion in the prior quarter and $9.30 billion year over year.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Record revenue substantially exceeded prior-quarter and year-ago levels.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: Fiscal Q3 2026 highlights • Revenue of $41.46 billion versus $23.86 billion for the prior quarter and $9.30 billion for the same period last year

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Profitability expanded materially in fiscal Q3 2026, with GAAP gross margin of 84.6% versus 74.4% in Q2 and 37.7% in the year-ago quarter.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Gross margin rose sharply both sequentially and year over year.
earnings_release_evidence.notes: Excerpt includes GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin rows; GAAP percentages are 84.6%, 74.4%, and 37.7%.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Micron delivered GAAP EPS of $24.67 and non-GAAP EPS of $25.11 in fiscal Q3 2026, compared with $1.68 and $1.91, respectively, in the year-ago quarter.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: EPS and net income reached very elevated levels versus the prior year.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: GAAP net income of $28.24 billion, or $24.67 per diluted share • Non-GAAP net income of $28.86 billion, or $25.11 per diluted share

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Operating cash flow rose to $25.39 billion in fiscal Q3 2026, and adjusted free cash flow was $18.3 billion after $7.1 billion of net capex.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Cash generation scaled significantly while the company continued heavy investment.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: Operating cash flow of $25.39 billion versus $11.90 billion for the prior quarter and $4.61 billion for the same period last year
earnings_release_evidence.notes: The same release states: “For the third quarter of 2026, investments in capital expenditures, net (2) were $7.1 billion and adjusted free cash flow (2) was $18.3 billion.”

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Management attributed record Q3 results and a stronger Q4 outlook to the strategic value of memory in the AI era and rapidly growing customer demand.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: CEO commentary was strongly positive on AI-driven memory demand and investment needs.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: “Micron’s record fiscal Q3 financial results and even stronger outlook for Q4 reflect the strategic value of memory in the AI era,” said Sanjay Mehrotra, Chairman, President and CEO of Micron Technology. “Micron is investing at record levels in technology, products and supply to address our customers’ rapidly growing demand.

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: Micron said multi-year Strategic Customer Agreements should improve the durability and predictability of financial performance.
earnings_release_evidence.summary: Strategic customer agreements are presented as improving predictability of future performance.
earnings_release_evidence.excerpt: We believe our multi-year Strategic Customer Agreements will significantly enhance the durability and predictability of Micron’s strong financial performance.”

earnings_release_evidence.title: 8-K earnings-release exhibit: a2026q3ex991-pressrelease.htm
earnings_release_evidence.claim: HBM product execution appears advanced, with HBM4 in high-volume shipments for a lead customer platform and HBM4E volume production expected in calendar 2027.
